entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Man, we really don't got a[n]good place to train, huh...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I mean, we'd prolly run into Nakaoka[n]and them if we stuck around here...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: You got any ideas?
Let's stay here.
How about Protein Lovers?
We can train at my place.[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Uh, were you listenin'? I don't wanna[n]run into those guys. Try an' think about[n]how I feel!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: And don't tell me I don't got feelin's![n]I'm full of emotion!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Not today, man. No way.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I didn't bring any spare undies, so I'm not[n]goin' anywhere near there.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: You seriously think we'd get any trainin'[n]done there?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I bet we'd just end up eatin' ice cream[n]and playin' video games all day long.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: That's just kinda what happens, y'know?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: ...Eh, I guess it won't hurt to peek 'round[n]the gym. If they ain't there, maybe we can—

entries.speaker: Familiar voice
entries.en: Hrgh!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: ...Nakaoka?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Takeishi? The hell you guys doin'?

entries.speaker: Takeishi
entries.en: We just have a few questions for Nakaoka[n]here. It's none of your business.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: So what, you gonna ask him questions[n]with your fists? And anyways, ain't[n]a three-on-one kinda cowardly?

entries.speaker: Takeishi
entries.en: The only coward here is Nakaoka![n]All the shit Kamoshida put us through[n]is his fault...

entries.speaker: Takeishi
entries.en: He was telling that bastard secrets[n]about us the whole time!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Huh? That's a load of bull!
You guys should trust Nakaoka.[clr 27]
This is no time for arguing.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: That's right! You've been trainin' together[n]for freakin' forever!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Plus, ain't the track team comin' back?[n]You don't gotta fight!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Y-Yeah! I mean, the track team's comin'[n]back, so you don't gotta fight!

entries.speaker: Takeishi
entries.en: ...Sh-Shut up!

entries.speaker: Takeishi
entries.en: I'm telling you, this piece of shit[n]sold us out!

entries.speaker: Takeishi
entries.en: How do you think Kamoshida found out[n]about your parents, Sakamoto?

entries.speaker: Brown-Haired Track Member
entries.en: He's gotta be a snitch!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: H-Hold up!

entries.speaker: Takeishi
entries.en: Out of the way, Sakamoto. We'll beat[n]the shit outta you too if we need to.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: If you think that's gonna make you[n]feel better, go for it.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: ...But you're gonna wish you didn't.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Trust me, it feels real bad lookin' back[n]on shitty stuff you've done.

entries.speaker: Brown-Haired Track Member
entries.en: Huh?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Look...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Even if Nakaoka was workin' with[n]Kamoshida... ain't it fine now?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: The bastard's gone, so you guys can just[n]put this crap behind you.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: There's no reason to fight, yeah?

entries.speaker: Takeishi
entries.en: We can't keep people around who're[n]gonna try and undermine our team.

entries.speaker: Nakaoka
entries.en: But... I didn't do anything. I wasn't[n]working with Kamoshida.

entries.speaker: Nakaoka
entries.en: No matter how much you hit me,[n]my answer's gonna stay the same.

entries.speaker: Takeishi
entries.en: Oh yeah? We've got proof.

entries.speaker: Takeishi
entries.en: Yamauchi told us all about it.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: ...Yamauchi?

entries.speaker: Short-Haired Track Member
entries.en: C'mon, Takeishi, we gotta get out of here.[n]It'd be real bad if anyone else showed up.

entries.speaker: Takeishi
entries.en: ...Nakaoka. Shit like you isn't welcome[n]on our new track team. You'd better[n]remember that.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: ...You okay?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: What the hell was all that?

entries.speaker: Nakaoka
entries.en: Just stay out of this, Sakamoto.[n]It has nothing to do with you.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: But...

entries.speaker: Nakaoka
entries.en: When you hit Kamoshida, you were[n]really hitting all of us who tried so hard[n]to endure his bullshit.

entries.speaker: Nakaoka
entries.en: You might've felt relieved, but it only[n]made life harder for us...

entries.speaker: Nakaoka
entries.en: 'Cause of you, we lost the one place we[n]could vent our frustrations... the one[n]place we could really belong.

entries.speaker: Nakaoka
entries.en: Tensions got pretty high after that...[n]and things've just been kinda rough[n]from then on.

entries.speaker: Nakaoka
entries.en: ...You really think it's all fine now, huh?[n]Well what if I told you they're right[n]about me?

entries.speaker: Nakaoka
entries.en: Would you still think it's "fine" if I was[n]the one who told Kamoshida about[n]your parents?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Yeah.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: If you told him, you told him. I'm over[n]all that stuff with my parents anyways.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Besides...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I've realized something, Nakaoka.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I might've messed up with Kamoshida[n]back then, but hangin' on to the past[n]ain't gonna help anythin'.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I'm just gonna focus on bein' myself[n]now... on bein' free.

entries.speaker: Nakaoka
entries.en: What're you talking about?

entries.speaker: Nakaoka
entries.en: Free, huh? Haha...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: [fName]... You get what I'm tryin'[n]to say, yeah?
Absolutely.[clr 27]
More or less.
Not in the slightest.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Right? He's the one who wasn't makin'[n]any sense.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Right? Wait, whaddya mean "more or[n]less"? You're s'posed to know...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: You kiddin' me!? Was I talkin' in a foreign[n]language or something?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I guess bein' free is like...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: It's like how I feel when I'm talkin'[n]to you, man.
I don't get it.
Can you explain that?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Uhhh, I don't know what else I gotta say.[n]I just feel... free.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Uhhh, I don't know how else to explain.[n]I just feel... free.
...Huh?
I really don't understand.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: What, we stuck on repeat or something?[n]Hahaha!
I feel like my bond with Ryuji[n]is growing deeper...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Mannn, that was some funny shit.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: ...So much for trainin' though, huh?[n]C'mon, let's get outta here.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Oooh, we should grab ramen on the[n]way home!
